introText.part1: EKORU wasn't born from a brilliant idea, it was born from a real discomfort,
introText.part2: and from the conviction that yes, there is another way to live. Enough of so much consumption, so much waste, so much disconnection.
introText.part4: that doesn't wait for the world to change... it changes it. We're not perfect, and we're not interested in being so, but each person who joins lights a spark. And together,

items.title: We believe in care.
items.text: For people, for things, for the planet we share.

items.title: We believe in trust.
items.text: We're not here to compete. We're here to build community.

items.title: We believe in action.
items.text: We're not here to decorate speeches. We're here to make things happen.

items.text: We don't speak as a brand. We speak like you. And we think with you.
